name: toast
title: Toast
description: Stacked toasts in a top-layer region: toast(), success, error, warning, info, loading and promise, with actions, swipe to dismiss, paused timers and live announcements. CSS-only motion.

.rx-toast.transition: --_fill 150ms var(--motion-ease), opacity 200ms var(--motion-ease), filter var(--spring-toast-duration) var(--spring-toast), translate var(--spring-toast-duration) var(--spring-toast), scale var(--spring-toast-duration) var(--spring-toast), height var(--spring-toast-duration) var(--spring-toast), display 200ms allow-discrete

.rx-toast[data-removed].transition: opacity 200ms var(--motion-ease), filter 200ms var(--motion-ease), translate 200ms var(--motion-ease), scale 200ms var(--motion-ease), display 200ms allow-discrete

.rx-toast-icon > svg.transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), scale var(--spring-swap-duration) var(--spring-swap), filter 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)

.rx-toast-content.transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), translate var(--spring-swap-duration) var(--spring-swap), filter 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)

.rx-toast-close.transition: opacity 150ms var(--motion-ease), color 150ms var(--motion-ease), background-color 150ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-press-duration) var(--spring-press)
